# Chapter 2: How to Study Comparative Politics – Using Comparative Methods

## 2.1: The Scientific Method in Comparative Politics

::: callout-note
### Learning Objectives

By the end of this section, you will be able to:

- Explain how comparative political scientists apply the scientific method to study political systems.
- Distinguish between qualitative and quantitative research methods in comparative politics.
- Evaluate the strengths and limitations of case studies, small-N comparisons, and large-N statistical analyses.
:::
